title: Glowing hourglass
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='woodTop' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#d9a05b'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#b87a3a'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='woodBot' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#b87a3a'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#8f5a26'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='sandTop' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#ffe066'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#ffb347'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='sandBot' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#ffc247'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#ff8c1a'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <radialGradient id='glassGlow' cx='0.5' cy='0.5' r='0.6'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#bff3ff' stop-opacity='0.55'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#7fd6ff' stop-opacity='0.15'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- glow aura -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='50' rx='34' ry='44' fill='#5fe0ff' opacity='0.18'/>

  <!-- glass body -->
  <path d='M30 20 L70 20 C70 20 62 32 52 48 C62 64 70 80 70 80 L30 80 C30 80 38 64 48 48 C38 32 30 20 30 20 Z' fill='url(#glassGlow)' stroke='#9fe8ff' stroke-width='2'/>

  <!-- top sand -->
  <path d='M37 26 C37 26 44 34 50 44 C56 34 63 26 63 26 Z' fill='url(#sandTop)'/>
  <path d='M40 30 C43 34 47 40 50 45 C50 39 50 33 50 30 Z' fill='#fff3b0' opacity='0.7'/>

  <!-- falling stream -->
  <rect x='49' y='46' width='2' height='20' fill='#ffd24d'/>
  <rect x='49' y='46' width='1' height='20' fill='#fff3b0' opacity='0.8'/>

  <!-- bottom pile -->
  <path d='M38 80 L62 80 C62 80 58 70 50 68 C42 70 38 80 38 80 Z' fill='url(#sandBot)'/>
  <path d='M44 73 C46 71 48 70 50 70 C50 74 50 77 50 79 L44 79 C44 77 44 75 44 73 Z' fill='#ffe08a' opacity='0.8'/>

  <!-- sparkles -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='38' r='1.6' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.9'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='40' r='1.3' fill='#c8f6ff' opacity='0.9'/>
  <circle cx='45' cy='60' r='1.2' fill='#ffe9a8' opacity='0.9'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='58' r='1.5' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.85'/>

  <!-- wooden caps -->
  <rect x='24' y='14' width='52' height='8' rx='4' fill='url(#woodTop)'/>
  <rect x='24' y='14' width='52' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#ffd28a' opacity='0.6'/>
  <rect x='24' y='78' width='52' height='8' rx='4' fill='url(#woodBot)'/>
  <rect x='24' y='78' width='52' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#e0a860' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- tiny feet for cuteness -->
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='88' rx='6' ry='2.6' fill='#8f5a26'/>
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='88' rx='6' ry='2.6' fill='#8f5a26'/>

  <!-- highlights on glass -->
  <path d='M36 26 C34 34 36 42 40 50' stroke='#ffffff' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' opacity='0.7' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M64 74 C66 66 64 58 60 50' stroke='#ffffff' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none' opacity='0.4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
